question: What is the scientific name of the fruit mango?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangifera Indica**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mangifera Indica** is the scientific name of the mango fruit.
 
• The mango is a tropical fruit belonging to the genus **Mangifera**, which consists of numerous species of tropical fruiting trees in the flowering plant family **Anacardiaceae**.
 
• Mangoes are native to South Asia, from where they have been distributed worldwide to become one of the most cultivated fruits in the tropics.
 
• The mango is the national fruit of India, Pakistan, and the Philippines, and the national tree of Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mangoes** have been cultivated in South Asia for thousands of years.
 
• The fruit varies in size, shape, and color, with a typical mango being oval-shaped and having a smooth, leathery skin that ranges from green to yellow to red.
 
• Mangoes are rich in vitamins A and C, and are used in a variety of culinary applications, from fresh consumption to being an ingredient in chutneys, pickles, and desserts.
 
• The **Mangifera Indica** tree can grow up to 100 feet tall and has a long lifespan, often bearing fruit for several decades.
 
• Due to its popularity and economic importance, the mango is sometimes referred to as the "king of fruits."
